name: French Austral Lands and Seas
description: These remote sub-Antarctic islands in the southern Indian Ocean, the Crozet, Kerguelen, and Saint-Paul and Amsterdam groups plus dozens of tiny islets, are French territory. No one lives there permanently, only researchers and support staff. Surrounded by more than 166 million hectares of ocean, they shelter vast colonies of seabirds and seals, including the world's largest populations of king penguins and yellow-nosed albatrosses.
